Description: 'Registered' is undefined: who registers depositors, with what criteria, and can registration be revoked?
Suggested fix: Define a Depositor Registry, registration authority, criteria and revocation rule.

Description: No behaviour for rejected deposits or for boxes of a depositor deregistered after depositing.
Suggested fix: Add rejection handling and a policy for boxes of deregistered depositors.

Description: 'A large number of boxes' has no figure.
Suggested fix: Delete S2 or state a minimum capacity per chamber.

Description: S2 is fully superseded by the concrete limits in S3.
Suggested fix: Merge S2 into S3.

Description: Capacity counted in boxes, but box size/volume is not fixed, and it is unclear whether chambers are fixed at 4 (scenario says 'several').
Suggested fix: State box dimensions or a unit-of-capacity rule and the fixed chamber list.

Description: No rule on capacity when a chamber is under maintenance: where do its boxes go, and does the receiving chamber's limit still hold?
Suggested fix: Add a relocation rule that respects limits and S7.

Description: Scenario says 'several freezer chambers'; S3 hard-codes four with different capacities.
Suggested fix: Use one authoritative chamber list (ID, capacity).

Description: 'Belongs' and 'that depositor' undefined for mergers, dissolution or delegated agents.
Suggested fix: Define ownership transfer and authorised-agent rules.

Description: S4: only the owner may withdraw; S5: authority may release any box to any party.
Suggested fix: Make S4 'except under S5 emergency release' and define S5 conditions.

Description: 'Emergency' is undefined and no one is named to declare it.
Suggested fix: Define emergency criteria and the declaring body.

Description: 'Vault authority' is not a defined role; 'any requesting party' is unbounded.
Suggested fix: Define the role and vetting of requesters.

Description: Emergency release has no audit, owner notification, or post-release ownership rule.
Suggested fix: Require logging, owner notice and chain-of-custody records.

Description: Unclear whether emergency releases count toward the owner's 20% yearly quota; both readings conflict with either S5 ('any box') or S10 ('at most').
Suggested fix: State that emergency releases are excluded from the quota.

Description: 'Safe temperature' has no numeric value, and 'safe' for what is unstated.
Suggested fix: Replace with a numeric range tied to seed species.

Description: S6 is the general form of S7; two statements to keep in sync.
Suggested fix: Fold S6 into S7.

Description: 0C during maintenance may not be 'safe' under S6 for stored seeds.
Suggested fix: Define a bounded, authorised exception to S6.

Description: 'Never' over a continuous quantity is untestable; no measurement point, sensor, tolerance or sampling interval.
Suggested fix: Specify sensors, sampling period and alarm threshold.

Description: S7 forbids temperatures above -18C; S8 permits 0C.
Suggested fix: Add 'except during authorised maintenance (S8)' with duration limit.

Description: No rule for boxes present during warming, maximum duration, authorisation, or notification of depositors.
Suggested fix: Require evacuation or a maximum exposure time plus approval and notice.

Description: 'May be warmed' is a permission with no actor, trigger, or end condition.
Suggested fix: Rewrite as 'shall only be warmed when ...'.

Description: 'Low viability' and 'promptly' have no threshold or time bound.
Suggested fix: State a viability % per species and a flag deadline.

Description: No statement of who measures viability, how often, or who is notified and acts on the flag.
Suggested fix: Add testing schedule, responsible role and notification.

Description: Viability testing is destructive and slow, so prompt flagging of every box is not physically achievable.
Suggested fix: Use sampling-based monitoring with a stated confidence level.

Description: Regeneration needs a withdrawal; S4 allows only the owner, and S10 may block it through the 20% quota.
Suggested fix: Exempt regeneration from the quota and define who may perform it.

Description: 'Per year' (calendar or rolling), the baseline count (start of year or current), and rounding are undefined.
Suggested fix: Define window, baseline and rounding.

Description: Effect of redeposit on the quota count is unspecified.
Suggested fix: State whether redeposited boxes restore quota.

Description: 'Species' is the quota basis, but the scenario's 'one species per box' rule is not in S1-S12.
Suggested fix: Add a requirement that each box has exactly one species attribute.

Description: 'Re-inspection' lacks inspector, criteria and pass/fail outcome; failure handling missing.
Suggested fix: Define inspection procedure, criteria and failure path.

Description: Does not say the redeposit retains original ownership or must satisfy S1/S3.
Suggested fix: Add ownership and capacity checks to redeposit.

Description: 'A good audit trail' is subjective.
Suggested fix: List events, fields (who/what/when), and completeness test.

Description: No retention period, tamper protection, or access control for the audit trail.
Suggested fix: Add retention, append-only and access rules.

Description: Scenario states staff handle deposits, withdrawals and monitoring and the vault is a custodian, but no requirement defines staff roles or custodianship.
Suggested fix: Add role requirements and trace IDs to scenario sentences.

Description: Assumes a defined set of boxes per species at a defined time; no inventory snapshot rule.
Suggested fix: Record an annual inventory snapshot.
